coverage.materials: All six artifacts, receipts and tool-event files; both frozen SKILL.md files; relevant native helpers; both fixture producers; original and supplemental execution receipts; packet, request, supplement and independent-supplements-review.json.
coverage.reviewer_operations: Read-only file inspection and digest verification. No producer/helper execution, network operation, delegation or file write.

integrity.timing_qualification: Recorded supplement creation precedes all model trials, and trace timestamps fall inside their recorded trial intervals. Matching current hashes and recorded timestamps do not independently authenticate historical immutability, serving identity or complete transitive dependency provenance.
integrity.packet_status_interpretation: prepared-not-executed is a frozen preparation field. Later trial receipts establish recorded execution; the packet is not a live execution-status file.

A.leaf-existing: Success result conceals a changed non-target sentinel inside workspaceRoot.
A.leaf-dangling: Success result creates the missing non-target referent inside workspaceRoot.
A.polluted-git-env: Fails with not-a-git-repo; intended exclude remains unchanged and other repository exclude is preserved.
A.outside-existing-leaf: Actual outside-workspace existing sentinel is rejected and preserved.
A.outside-dangling-leaf: Success result creates a genuinely outside-workspace missing referent.
A.outside-dangling-ancestor: Rejected; external missing referent remains absent.
A.snapshot-identity-under-overrides: Repository snapshot retains repo_id=a while changing to b's HEAD, clean status and empty fingerprint. Separate source snapshot remains bound to a.

B.leaf-dangling: Safely rejected; update incomplete and no referent created.
B.ancestor-dangling: Safely rejected; update incomplete and no referent created.
B.polluted-git-env: Successful intended-repository update under the tested overrides; other repository exclude preserved.
B.outside-dangling-leaf: Safely rejected; no outside referent created.
B.outside-dangling-ancestor: Safely rejected; no outside referent created.
B.snapshot-identity-under-overrides: Both repository and source snapshots preserved; a's dirty worktree remains visible.

identity_and_byte_scope: The original producer supplies workspaceRoot equal to the case directory containing a, b and outside. Its outside label does not establish workspace escape.
The supplemental producer places outside beside workspace and selects workspace/a. It supplies exact intended identity even where A's resolved rejected target points only to outside/sentinel.
Original other_exclude_preserved compares the other repository's exclude-file digest only, not every byte in that repository.
Supplemental containment cases provide sentinel, symlink, referent-existence and directory-entry observations, not complete filesystem byte inventories.
Snapshot contamination is a read-identity defect; it does not establish a write to repository b.
Both source snapshots retain host-config-path-escape and host-config-containment-root-missing limitations.

optimization_assessment.recommendation: Retain B's source-level helper changes for the tested containment and repository-identity defects.
supported_improvements: Retaining the unresolved Git metadata path prevents canonicalization from hiding original symlink segments.
lstat-based segment checks detect dangling links before writes.
Contained staged publication replaces direct destination writes.
Shared sanitized Git execution binds repository snapshots and exclude resolution to the selected repository under tested overrides.
attribution: A is pre-optimization spec-first, not upstream CE.
A and B SKILL.md are byte-identical; these observations do not demonstrate prose compression or prompt optimization.
A already protects source-snapshot Git calls. Source snapshot preservation is a shared positive control, not a newly demonstrated B-only gain.
All six model outputs interpret their assigned evidence correctly. Different fixture outcomes do not establish model-level B superiority.
The parent executed disposable helper fixtures; models interpreted receipts rather than autonomously performing runtime setup.
optimization_assessment.bounded_acceptance: Complete review acceptance for the nine supplied case interpretations, with minor identity-detail omissions in A1/A3. Supported local mechanism improvement in B.
remaining_unverified: Full setup orchestration and real host installation/configuration consumption.
